Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from the Champions League, as Napoli and Kevin De Bruyne visit Manchester City, while Como take on AEK Athens.
Both fixtures kick off at 20.00 GMT (21.00 CET) in Matchday 5 of 8 in this league phase.
While Como are in fourth place after three victories and one defeat, Napoli risk early elimination following just one win and three losses so far.
This is a special game for De Bruyne against his former club, especially as last season he had to leave the field early following Giovanni Di Lorenzo’s red card on 21 minutes.

AEK Athens: Strakosha; Rota, Moukoudi, Relvas, Pilos; Majer, R Marin, Vitalis, Kutesa; Jovic, Gacinovic
Ref: Rojas (ESP)
“It’s a wonderful stadium and playing against a team like City gives you motivation. We must try to win the match,” Olivera told Sky Sport Italia.
“One has to adapt to where the coach wants, but tonight due to injuries and other issues, I am playing this position. I hope to do well, have a great game, and see a good Napoli tonight.
“It is certainly an incredible emotion for De Bruyne to be back against the team where he spent so much of his life.”
